responsibility: Provides the older Linux ELF target configuration layer for Arm. It sets the default hard-float ABI, endian-dependent linker emulation and target defaults, Linux-specific linker and library specs, GNU user builtins, profiling hooks, frame-pointer requirements for mcount, executable-stack notes, symbol-binding policy, and static stack-check support, serving as the non-EABI Linux ELF specialization above the generic Arm ELF setup.
